plan.title: Live RFQ with two vendor bids

steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen for the RFQ setup.
Use the required title for the reusable two-bid RFQ.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction stage.
Configure the RFQ stage before selecting its template and items.
Apply the RFQ pricing template required for line items and bidding.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Set the requested delivery location on the line item.
Complete the remaining required RFQ pricing-sheet fields.
Commit a live bidding schedule so the RFQ can be published.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors for the two competing bids.
Publish the RFQ so vendors can submit quotes.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Submit Vendor A's portal bid at 100 per unit.
Confirm the first vendor's quote was accepted by the vendor portal.
Submit Vendor B's separate portal bid at 90 per unit.
Confirm the second vendor's quote was accepted by the vendor portal.
Verify the buyer sees two direct vendor responses and full participation.
Open the buyer's comparison grid to verify the bid values and totals.
Verify the first vendor's quoted unit price is 100.
Verify the second vendor's quoted unit price is 90.
Verify each total is calculated as unit price times quantity, yielding 1,000 and 900.
Return to the Responses view named by the expected result.
Finish by asserting that Responses still shows both vendor bids.
